map.在线情感分析工具，本地对文本进行正负面倾向识别并标注情感标签与置信度，适合评论与: An online sentiment analysis tool that detects positive and negative tendency in text locally, tags the sentiment and reports confidence. Ideal for quickly judging reviews and public opinion, running entirely in the front end.
map.在浏览器本地对文本做正/负/中性倾向识别，输出情感标签与置信度。: Identifies positive, negative and neutral tendency in text locally in the browser and outputs a sentiment label with a confidence score.
map.纯前端运行，文本不上传，适合评论、舆情与客服消息快速判断。: Runs entirely in the front end and the text is never uploaded, suitable for quickly judging reviews, public opinion and customer service messages.
map.基于轻量模型，对讽刺、反语与上下文依赖句识别有限，结果供辅助。: Because it relies on a lightweight model, sarcasm, irony and context-dependent sentences are only partly recognised; treat the output as supporting information.
map.：输入'这家店服务太差，再也不来了' → 标签'负面', 置信度 0.92。'还: Input 'the service in this shop is terrible, I will never come back' → label 'negative', confidence 0.92. 'It is okay, nothing special' → 'neutral'. The model may misjudge indirect expressions such as sarcasm.
map.轻量本地模型难捕讽刺、双重否定与领域黑话；强需求可用云端大模型配合上下文，但涉及: A lightweight local model struggles with irony, double negation and jargon; if you really need this, use a cloud large model with context, but first assess privacy because the text leaves the device.
